csv_project_name: Preliminary Design for Lower Road Trail Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Town of Brunswick may be seeking Preliminary Design service for Lower Road Trail Improvement. Maine DOT commissioned the Lower Road Rail Use Advisory Council to examine converting the old railroad track spur that went from Brunswick to Augusta for possible re-use. This state-owned rail corridor will be converted to a 34 mile multimodal trail which will connect Brunswick and Augusta, and the towns in between. About 0.75 miles of the trail will be located in Brunswick
